verdict.rationale: Pinecone's own multitenancy guide recommends isolating tenants with one namespace per tenant in a serverless index, so the core isolation mechanism is first-party and documented. The evidence does not show any documented limits, such as maximum namespaces per index, or any claim that this isolation is cheap at scale. Missing for 10: documented namespace/tenant count limits, evidence of cost-efficiency for many tenants, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant scale.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can isolate many tenants cheaply using namespaces, partitions, or per-tenant collections with documented limits

citations.quote: Implement multitenancy in Pinecone using a **serverless index with one namespace per tenant**.
